name: model-router
description: Routes each turn to the cheapest model + effort that fits the task (Haiku 5.5 → Sonnet 5.5 → Opus 5.5 → Fable 5.1) and shows the ladder in a side pane. Local fork: per-prompt history + step-up when you say a turn was wrong.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: haiku: a ~1s Haiku 5.5 call grades each prompt (heuristics as fallback). heuristic: keyword/shape scoring only, zero cost.

ceiling.title: Highest model allowed
ceiling.description: Cost cap: the router never picks a model above this one.

stickiness.title: Downgrade stickiness (rungs)
stickiness.description: While the prompt cache is warm, only step down the ladder when the new pick is at least this many rungs lower. Upgrades always apply.

routeAgents.title: Route subagents and workflow agents
routeAgents.description: Step each subagent / workflow agent down to the cheapest model that fits its task. Never raises an agent above the model it would have used.
